lighthouse_detail: full audits extracted from REST live response; all failing non-informational audits stored per URL (sorted severity then LCP savings), not just top 5, so month-over-month diffs are not distorted by truncation
environment_caveats: Audited the apex production origin (https://purocleaneastlasvegas.com). The client record has no apex_cutover.completed_at but has cut_over_at=2026-07-23 and the apex serves 200 with no x-robots-tag, so the staging noindex correction does not apply and SEO counts toward the verdict.

Canonical scoring is DESKTOP (formFactor=desktop), recorded in audit_form_factor. Lighthouse and instant_pages were called through the DataForSEO REST API directly (on_page/lighthouse/live/json with for_mobile false and true), so a supplementary mobile pass is stored per URL under .mobile and in site_rollup.avg_scores_mobile.

Lighthouse lab scores are single-run measurements. Month-over-month deltas of a few points or ~100-200ms LCP are within normal run-to-run variance; the mobile regression flagged this month is larger than that and has an identified cause (new GA4 gtag.js on every page, unused-javascript newly failing on all 6 URLs, mobile TBT up from 0-2ms to 27-264ms).

has_micromarkup_errors (5 of 6 URLs) is carried at low severity for the same reason documented in the 2026-08-27 audit: the validator messages are optional-field warnings (FAQPage Question.text/answerCount, trailing BreadcrumbList item). The one real schema defect, "foundingDate": "" in Organization and LocalBusiness JSON-LD, was re-verified on the live HTML and is still present; it has no Lighthouse or DataForSEO check ID so it lives in the report recommendations only.
INP is null on every URL: interaction-to-next-paint is a field metric and is not produced by a Lighthouse lab run.
clients/puroclean-east-las-vegas.json has status="live", not "active". build_status=pushed_main and the apex serves 200, so the audit proceeded.
